affordance_in_statement: Vehicles assigned to the same lane cannot overlap (their intervals can at most touch at the endpoints). For every team i, its primary vehicle must be parked ahead of its secondary vehicle (the primary vehicle's end coordinate must be less than or equal to the secondary vehicle's start coordinate).
secondary_shortcut_name: JOB-first scan under the unique-certificate guarantee
removal_suggestion: Replace the zero-clearance convention with a mandatory one-meter clearance between any two ordered vehicle intervals, including the primary-secondary pair. This preserves the scenario and formats while making exact-capacity cases contradictory.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Checks each pair using p1+p2>T, then checks each lane by summing all vehicle lengths.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Intervals may touch at endpoints and the primary end may equal the secondary start.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses total lane sums and p1+p2>T as complete feasibility tests, outputting the first JOB found.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Non-overlapping intervals on a length-T lane can be packed with no required gaps.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Checks every JOB with p1+p2>T and otherwise compares total primary and secondary lengths with T.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Endpoint touching is allowed for both lane packing and team ordering.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Treats pair sums and lane sums as the exact contradiction criteria.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The rules use non-strict endpoint inequalities and permit intervals to touch.

common_affordance: The rules reduce every isolated contradiction to zero-clearance one-dimensional packing: a pair fails exactly when p1+p2>T, and a lane fails exactly when the sum of its vehicle lengths exceeds T.
recommended_edit: Change the physical rules so that any two vehicles that are ordered along the coordinate axis must have at least one meter of clear space between them, including each primary-secondary pair; regenerate the guaranteed-unique inputs accordingly.
